quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Dinglong half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: H1 revenue RMB 1,924,595,428.40, up 11.15%, mainly on higher semiconductor sales; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 484,683,042.71, up 65.00% (net profit attributable up 70.21%, or up 74.57% excluding the deconsolidated printing-consumables terminal business). Semiconductor revenue rose to 65.6% of the total. Cost of sales fell 9.86% to RMB 792,335,346.57 after the company sold control of its Zhuhai Mingtu Chaojun and Jixun Technology printing-consumables subsidiaries. The company cites rising semiconductor-materials demand from AI compute and memory chips, the newly acquired Haofei New Materials and cost control; wafer photoresist and advanced packaging materials were still not profitable.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue RMB 1,924,595,428.40 (+11.15%); net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 484,683,042.71 (+65.00%); semiconductor 65.6% of revenue

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Dinglong half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue by product: semiconductor materials (CMP pads, slurries, cleaning solutions, YPI, PSPI, TFE-INK, temporary bonding adhesive, packaging PI, wafer photoresist, chips) RMB 1,262,469,442.78, up 33.87%; printing and copying consumables RMB 410,247,216.64, down 47.35%, gross margin 29.46%; new energy materials and other RMB 251,878,768.98, gross margin 41.02%. The toner-cartridge and ink-cartridge terminal business was divested in April 2026 (its Q1 consolidated revenue was RMB 2.59 hundred million); the color toner business was kept. Haofei New Materials, consolidated from March 2026, had product sales of RMB 2.45 hundred million in the consolidated period, up 60.14%, with several products in steady volume supply to leading domestic power and energy-storage battery makers; its Xiantao anode binder has begun small shipments and water-based separator binder and dispersant capacity there is expected to be built in H2 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: semiconductor materials RMB 1,262,469,442.78 (+33.87%); printing consumables RMB 410,247,216.64 (-47.35%); new energy materials and other RMB 251,878,768.98; Haofei sales RMB 2.45 hundred million (+60.14%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Dinglong half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CMP polishing pads: Q2 2026 product sales RMB 3.69 hundred million, up 44.48% year over year. Shipments and share of pads for advanced process nodes keep rising and domestic market share is rising steadily. The pad subsidiary Dinghui Microelectronics had H1 revenue of RMB 747,289,443.19.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Dinglong half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Wafer photoresist: the Qianjiang phase-2 300-ton-a-year KrF/ArF line was completed and put into production at the end of Q1 2026 and is in capacity ramp-up, with delivery capability rising; the phase-1 30-ton line runs stably. Construction in progress on the 300-ton project was RMB 521,480,847.40 at June 30, 2026, 67.29% of its RMB 80395.3 ten-thousand budget, with project progress at 95.00%; total construction in progress was RMB 730,772,578.97, up mainly on the photoresist project.
quarterly_data.figure: 300-ton line in production from end of Q1 2026; construction in progress RMB 521,480,847.40, 67.29% of budget, progress 95.00%

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Dinglong half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor display materials: H1 2026 product sales fell 12.73% year over year, which the company attributes mainly to insufficient downstream utilization; it says its market share and new-product coverage kept rising, with PSPI and TFE-INK share up and YPI's domestic lead stable. The display subsidiary Rouxian Technology had H1 revenue of RMB 245,244,149.47.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 display sales -12.73% YoY; Rouxian Technology H1 revenue RMB 245,244,149.47

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Dinglong half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Advanced packaging materials are in the sales ramp stage: the company has 8 semiconductor packaging PI products, 3 with orders from several customers; temporary bonding adhesive ships in steady volume to existing customers. Semiconductor equipment control systems (chip-design subsidiary): products include temperature calibration and control systems for electrostatic chucks in high-end etchers, UPA components for CMP equipment, heater temperature controllers and CVD node control boards; some are recognized by mainstream customers, with sales of over one million yuan.

quarterly_data.signal: Raised-fund projects at June 30, 2026: the optoelectronic semiconductor materials R&D and manufacturing center had RMB 2,240.77 ten-thousand of its RMB 15,500.00 ten-thousand convertible-bond allocation invested (14.46%), ready-for-use date September 2028; the upstream key raw materials localization base project (internal supply of materials) was fully invested with a June 2026 date.
